subject: LLP-Bench kickoff - one benchmark for all bag-level learning
body:
Team,

Kicking off LLP-Bench adoption. Bag-level learning is turning into a real product surface for privacy-constrained customers, and right now every internal effort evals differently. LLP-Bench fixes that: it's our open-source large-scale tabular benchmark with three bag constructions (feature bags, fixed-size feature bags, random bags), five train/test splits, and nine methods already wired in - the DLLP variants (BCE and MSE), easy_llp, genbags, mean_map, ot_llp, sim_llp, and both soft and hard erot_llp.

Goal for our short window: (1) full harness reproducing published numbers by March 13; (2) benchmark packaged with docs + AutoInt embedding assets by April 3; (3) adopted as the required eval in the portfolio's method reviews by April 24.

Bao - staffing and any tooling gaps this week please. This one is about execution speed, the research risk is low.

Dmitri
